concepts.name: AI Nervous System
concepts.thesis: Claude coordination, decision, copilot, and domain AIs should be one nervous system that senses, decides, and fires muscles — not sixteen sibling chat services.
concepts.silo: This organism: Module OS plugs all 25 named AIs; companion proposes; library answers. GitHub folders still declare WIRED while isComplete is false. Weather and spoilage still have no reflex.
concepts.prosperity: A recommendation only counts if it changes a farmer rupee — yield, price, cost, or risk — and can explain which organ it moved.

concepts.name: Energy Cost Intelligence
concepts.thesis: The question is not how many megawatts to install. It is how to cut the lifetime cost of energy for the village economy, measured in ₹ per kg, litre, and hour.
concepts.silo: Named RECIE in the missing-platforms analysis. This organism books declared kWh onto the village ledger and holds an energy window. No lifetime ₹/kg engine.
concepts.prosperity: Every kWh that spoils grain, idles a pump, or overprices logistics is a rupee taken from a farmer cell.

concepts.name: Food Value Intelligence
concepts.thesis: Food is scored on nutrition, satiety, taste, affordability, culture, digestibility, and convenience — not calories in a catalog row.
concepts.silo: This organism: FUS-v1 scores Chakhao and ginger on declared food axes. Affordability, household baskets, and FVIE culture still missing.
concepts.prosperity: A GI crop that people will actually cook, stay full on, and afford is the only crop that repeats as demand.

concepts.name: GI Marketplace
concepts.thesis: The market is the public face of the organism: GI lots, provenance, and fair offtake — not an isolated storefront.
concepts.silo: Product and order services plus MarketplacePage exist. Listings are not born from harvest events, not ranked by food-value, not priced with energy or logistics cost.
concepts.prosperity: Price received by the farmer, time-to-pay, and repeat offtake are the only market KPIs that matter.

concepts.name: Village Twin
concepts.thesis: A village is an economy with shared muscle, energy, water, storage, and governance — not a location string on a farmer row.
concepts.silo: villageService stores place data. The economic digital twin, shared-cost model, and village pulse were specified and never attached.
concepts.prosperity: Shared infrastructure only pays when the twin can say how many rupees per year the village saves.

concepts.name: Cold-chain Logistics
concepts.thesis: Movement of lots through weather, power, and time. Price of a shipment is energy + spoilage risk + pooling, not a freight table.
concepts.silo: logisticsService, tracking, freight pooling exist. They do not consume harvest events, warehouse intake, or energy cost, and they do not write spoilage back into insurance or RECIE.
concepts.prosperity: Spoilage avoided and hours saved are farmer rupees. Diesel and outage losses are village rupees.

concepts.name: Rural Finance
concepts.thesis: Credit, advances, EMI, and payouts should metabolise farmer health — FDI in, risk out, cash back after offtake.
concepts.silo: Loans, credit scoring, and EMI modules exist. FDI does not automatically reprice credit or insurance. Settlement does not close the demand loop.
concepts.prosperity: Cost of capital and days-to-payout are as real as farmgate price.

concepts.name: Crop & GI Genome
concepts.thesis: Variety, season, GI geography, and planting are the DNA of what the organism can become this year.
concepts.silo: This organism: one Magh planting per cell-variety, closed on harvest. GitHub crop_plantings vs farms vs farm_plots still collide.
concepts.prosperity: The right variety in the right season, already contracted, is the cheapest prosperity lever.

concepts.name: Farmer Cell
concepts.thesis: The farmer is a living cell — identity, household, land, FDI, and cashflow — not a role in an ACL table.
concepts.silo: This organism: the cell is a nucleus — household, acres, harvest, farmgate. GitHub still treats farmer as a role and a foreign key.
concepts.prosperity: Architectural rule: every organ must show a measurable path to this cell’s rupees.

concepts.name: Livestock
concepts.thesis: Animals are a second genome of the rural cell: milk, meat, draught, risk, and veterinary cost.
concepts.silo: livestockService and veterinary specs exist beside crop, not through it. This organism: Ronghang herd is a cell fact under POL-LANGTHASA-HERD. Chilling energy and milk rupees still missing.
concepts.prosperity: ₹ per litre chilled is the honest livestock KPI — not headcount.

concepts.name: Contract Farming
concepts.thesis: A contract is a ligament of trust: escrow, milestones, offtake, and next-season planning — not a PDF in a drawer.
concepts.silo: Contracts module exists. It is not born from demand spikes, culinary calendar, or village twin, and it does not write back into crop plans.
concepts.prosperity: A signed offtake before sowing is the farmer’s cheapest insurance.

concepts.name: Processing
concepts.thesis: Value addition is digestion: lots become food with energy, labour, and yield. Schedule follows village power, not a static roster.
concepts.silo: Processing appears in specs and some services. It is not driven by harvest intake, energy cloud, or food-value demand.
concepts.prosperity: Margin after energy, packaging, and offtake — attributed back to the farmer cell.

concepts.name: Soil & Climate Sense
concepts.thesis: Sensors, weather, and soil health are the organism’s feet on the ground. They should trigger muscle, not dashboards.
concepts.silo: This organism: Magh rain opens a claim window. A clerk-declared godown temperature lands on the twin. Live sensors and EMI freeze still missing.
concepts.prosperity: A weather alert that does not freeze credit, open a claim window, or retask logistics is just a notification.

concepts.name: Orders & Escrow
concepts.thesis: An order is a muscle contraction: cash, lot, logistics, and trust moving together.
concepts.silo: orderService, cart, checkout exist. Settlement does not reliably fire farmer payout, FDI update, and demand-signal in one motion.
concepts.prosperity: Hours from delivery to farmer credit is the order organ’s prosperity metric.

concepts.name: GI Trace & Trust
concepts.thesis: Every lot should carry an immune marker: geography, handler, temperature, and claim. Trust is not a badge, it is a chain.
concepts.silo: This organism: GI mint at harvest; a GI listing without the chain is blocked. GitHub certification still badges at checkout.
concepts.prosperity: GI premium captured by the farmer, not diluted by an untraced mix.

concepts.name: Insurance
concepts.thesis: Crop, transit, and warehouse cover should reflex when weather, spoilage, or outage hits — like immunity, not a separate portal.
concepts.silo: policies and claims services exist. They do not subscribe to weather, spoilage, or FDI, and premiums do not metabolise farmer health.
concepts.prosperity: A claim that pays before the next sowing is prosperity. A policy that never hears the weather is theatre.

concepts.name: Warehouse & Storage
concepts.thesis: Storage is the body’s reserve: moisture, temperature, tenure, and release into market or process.
concepts.silo: warehouseManagement exists. Intake is not the subscriber of HarvestCompleted. Energy cost of holding is invisible.
concepts.prosperity: ₹ of spoilage avoided minus ₹ of holding energy, attributed to the lot’s farmer.

concepts.name: ERP Spine
concepts.thesis: SAP/Oracle/custom sync is the bony spine — structure, not intelligence. It should carry the same events the organism already knows.
concepts.silo: erpService can push product, order, farmer. It is a batch hose, not a ligament. Master data and live lots diverge.
concepts.prosperity: ERP is justified only when it shortens settlement or unlocks offtake, not when it mirrors tables.

concepts.name: Shared Infrastructure
concepts.thesis: Tractors, dryers, packhouses, and cold rooms are village muscle. Booking them should reshape the farm calendar and the cost twin.
concepts.silo: Asset rental exists as a catalog. It does not write into crop calendar, yield model, or RCOP’s shared-vs-individual decision.
concepts.prosperity: Hours of asset use that a household could not afford alone, priced as rupees saved.

concepts.name: Demand Feedback
concepts.thesis: Veins return what happened: offtake, recipes, festival spikes, unpaid invoices. Without them the heart pumps blind.
concepts.silo: AI demand-forecast endpoints exist. Culinary calendar, household goals, and order settlement do not feed them. The learning loop was marked partial in the concept audit.
concepts.prosperity: Next season’s contract is the vein’s gift to the farmer cell.

concepts.name: Culinary Knowledge
concepts.thesis: Recipes are not a blog. They are a knowledge graph from variety to festival to household, the memory of why a crop is grown.
concepts.silo: Named GCIP. Completely missing. No graph from Chakhao to a Karbi kitchen to a festival spike to a sowing plan.
concepts.prosperity: A remembered dish that repeats every winter is more honest demand than a marketplace impression.

concepts.name: Rural Cost Optimizer
concepts.thesis: Optimise the cost of living and producing in a village — energy, water, fertiliser, logistics, finance — as one ledger.
concepts.silo: This organism: Langthasa village ledger books declared energy, water, freight, and spoilage grams. No 25-year TCO, no shared-vs-individual AI, no twin.
concepts.prosperity: The only question the liver asks: how many rupees per year does this save the village economy?

concepts.name: Water Cost Intelligence
concepts.thesis: Irrigation, drinking, processing, and livestock water are one fluid system. Pumping kWh, aquifer stress, and ₹ per litre must sit on the same ledger as energy.
concepts.silo: This organism: declared irrigation hours post to the village ledger. No pumping-cost engine, no shared-aquifer twin. RECIE and RCOP still lack a water cloud.
concepts.prosperity: ₹ per hour of irrigation and litres not wasted are rupees returned to the cell — the same rupees energy pretends to save alone.

concepts.name: FPO / Cooperative
concepts.thesis: An FPO is not an ACL role. It is collective tissue: pooled offtake, group credit, shared muscle, and a village that can bargain as one body.
concepts.silo: GAP-0043/0044: FPO management is partial; cooperative, SHG, PACS, and dairy society are documented only. The portal treats FPO as another login.
concepts.prosperity: A cell that cannot pool offtake or rent a dryer will always sell distress. Collective tissue is how small farms grow a spine.

concepts.name: Household Economy
concepts.thesis: Demand is a household, not a consumer SKU. Nutrition goals, kitchen memory, cashflow, and festival plates live here — the real offtake unit.
concepts.silo: REOS layer 7 is missing. Cart is SKU-in. Farmer is a role. There is no household ledger, no family goal, no kitchen as an economic actor.
concepts.prosperity: A rupee that feeds the household without a distress sale is prosperity. A marketplace that never sees the kitchen is guessing.

concepts.name: Government Knowledge
concepts.thesis: Schemes are not a PDF hunt. They are external blood: eligibility, ROI, application, renewal, composed into credit, energy, and water products.
concepts.silo: REOS missing layer 4. Finance products do not auto-compose with PM-KUSUM, irrigation, or warehouse subsidies. The farmer still discovers alone.
concepts.prosperity: A composed subsidy that lands before sowing is inclusion. A scheme the cell must google is exclusion with a portal.

concepts.name: Event Spine
concepts.thesis: The event bus is the blood. Harvest, weather, settlement, and spoilage should move as named pulses every organ can subscribe to — not in-memory logs.
concepts.silo: This organism: spine_events persist harvest.completed, warehouse.intake, order.settled, lot.ready. GitHub eventBus.js is still an in-memory stub with TODO on the queue.
concepts.prosperity: Blood that does not reach the cell is theatre. One pulse, many organs, one rupee path.

concepts.name: Living Lot
concepts.thesis: A sack of Chakhao is one body. Moisture, GI marker, cover, freight, and listing are tissues of the same lot — not six records in six modules.
concepts.silo: This organism: erp_lots is one body (grams, remaining_grams, GI marker). GitHub still births six ids. Cover, freight fever, and FUS are not yet tissues of the same sack.
concepts.prosperity: GI premium, spoilage avoided, and hours-to-pay can only be attributed if the lot stays one body from field to plate.

concepts.name: Village Energy Cloud
concepts.thesis: Mills, chillers, dryers, and cold rooms should run when the village cloud says power is cheapest and most reliable — one breath, many muscles.
concepts.silo: Named in RECIE 1.6. No forecast, no load balance, no cost allocation. Processing rostas are static. Cold chain pretends the grid is a given.
concepts.prosperity: ₹ per kg processed and ₹ per litre chilled, scheduled by the cloud, are the only honest energy KPIs.

concepts.name: Food Knowledge Graph
concepts.thesis: Recipe → variety → festival → satiety → household → sowing. The graph is the memory that makes demand honest and GI food more than a catalog row.
concepts.silo: GCIP and FVIE are both missing, so there is nothing to join. Marketplace has name, price, GI tag. No grandmother, no Magh, no child-acceptance.
concepts.prosperity: A remembered dish that repeats every winter is a contract the land can plan for. Impressions are not demand.

concepts.name: Prosperity Ledger
concepts.thesis: Every organ must show a measurable path to a farmer rupee. The ledger is the bile that makes metabolism visible — yield, price, cost, risk, hours-to-pay.
concepts.silo: This organism: farmgate, freight, and inputs post to the cell journal in paise. Village TCO, FDI, and AI rupee-attribution still do not share one liver.
concepts.prosperity: If it cannot name the cell, the rupees, and the organ that moved, it is not AFRERA. It is software adjacent to a village.

concepts.name: Hazard Reflex
concepts.thesis: Weather, outage, and spoilage should fire a documented reflex: cover window, EMI pause, retask freight, explain in rupees. A chatbot is not a reflex.
concepts.silo: weatherAdvisory is a page. Sixteen AI services do not subscribe as one arc. Insurance, credit, and logistics each wait to be told by a human.
concepts.prosperity: A flood that still extracts EMI is not rural finance. A warning that does not move a muscle is gossip.

concepts.name: Module Contract
concepts.thesis: An AI system is a module with a contract: operations, organs it may move, pulses it emits, commands a human must approve. A folder named M675100 is not a synapse.
concepts.silo: This organism: Module OS plugs 25 AIs with workflows, gates, and a rupee firewall. GitHub 544 folders still say WIRED; analysis.isComplete is false. Phase 2 on that branch was left intentionally separate.
concepts.prosperity: A companion that cannot mint a lot or name a rupee is not a second mind. It is another file next to the cell.

concepts.name: Digital Super-Organism
concepts.thesis: AFRERA is an India-first economic operating system, not an agriculture website. Concept → module → feature → user → workflow → rules → database → service → API → authorization → AI → ERP → page → component → test → telemetry is one chain. Four-level enhance follows classification.
concepts.silo: This organism: Stage 0 catalog classifies every named concept. GitHub still has competing COMPLETE reports and mock JWT. Dual-truth: kernel vs platform.
concepts.prosperity: A concept that cannot name a cell, a remaining gram, or a farmer rupee is documentation. Classification is the first ligament.

ligaments.name: Product belongs to a cell
ligaments.today: productService rows point at a farmer. This is a foreign key, not a pulse — but it is a real ligament.
ligaments.contract: Keep the FK. Promote it to harvest.completed so the listing is born, not merely owned.
ligaments.thought: Ownership is the thinnest possible bond. Necessary, not sufficient.

ligaments.name: Cart to order
ligaments.today: Cart, checkout, and orderService are wired. Commerce muscle does contract — then stops.
ligaments.contract: Preserve checkout. Attach settlement as the next fibre of the same muscle.
ligaments.thought: The hand can grip. It cannot yet feed the cell.

ligaments.name: Portal sees the field
ligaments.today: Farmer portal and agriculture services are among the most complete organs. They still speak in pages, not events.
ligaments.contract: The portal remains the skin. The harvest must leave the skin as blood.
ligaments.thought: A complete page is not a complete organ.

ligaments.name: HarvestCompleted fan-out
ligaments.signal: harvest.completed { lotId, giTag, moisture, villageId, farmerId }
ligaments.today: Organism: harvest mints one lot; spine_events carry harvest.completed. Warehouse still waits for a clerk to inward the same body. GitHub portal never publishes.
ligaments.contract: Spine publishes harvest.completed. Warehouse intake, insurance cover, GI trace mint, and marketplace draft-lot all subscribe. One lot object, four organs.
ligaments.thought: A sack of Chakhao is not four records in four modules. It is one body moving through the organism.

ligaments.name: Lot is born as a listing
ligaments.today: Organism: createOrder emits lot.ready on the same lot id with remaining mass. GitHub still CMS products.
ligaments.contract: After warehouse grades a lot, marketplace receives a draft listing already carrying GI, moisture, and farmer cell.
ligaments.thought: The market should sell what the land just grew, not what a CMS last typed.

ligaments.name: GI marker at birth
ligaments.today: Organism: harvest mints a GI chain (handler, Langthasa geography, Magh). A GI listing without the mint is blocked. GitHub still badges at checkout.
ligaments.contract: Trace mints at harvest. Listing without a marker cannot be sold as GI.
ligaments.thought: Trust is an immune marker, not a badge you add at checkout.

ligaments.name: Warehouse cover on intake
ligaments.today: Organism: intake at Langthasa godown binds POL-LANGTHASA-GODOWN. Magh plantings bind POL-LANGTHASA-WEATHER. Premium unknown.
ligaments.contract: Intake either binds an existing master policy or opens a cover gap alert on the spine.
ligaments.thought: Grain in a dark room without cover is an uninsured organ.

ligaments.name: FDI metabolises credit
ligaments.today: FDI is calculated in farmerService. Credit scoring is a separate AI endpoint. They do not share a pulse.
ligaments.contract: fdi.updated reprices credit line and insurance premium within the same day, with an explanation.
ligaments.thought: FDI is a development journey, not a cloned credit bureau score sitting next to a loan form.

ligaments.name: FDI reprices cover
ligaments.today: Insurance does not read FDI. A farmer who just certified and stored well pays the same as one who did not.
ligaments.contract: Immune system listens to the cell’s health. Better practice, cheaper cover, shown in rupees.
ligaments.thought: Immunity that ignores the cell’s condition is not immunity.

ligaments.name: Settlement is one motion
ligaments.today: Organism: settlement writes cash/farmgate/freight, requires paymentRef, credits the cell. GitHub wallets stay skeletons.
ligaments.contract: order.settled credits the farmer cell, writes hours-to-pay, updates FDI, and emits demand.observed.
ligaments.thought: An order that does not nourish the cell is just a receipt.

ligaments.name: Veins return offtake
ligaments.today: Organism: order.settled emits demand.observed with variety and grams. Forecast still does not reprice.
ligaments.contract: Every settled order is a vein. Forecast is a function of veins, not a prompt.
ligaments.thought: Without returning blood, the heart pumps into silence.

ligaments.name: Sensor ownership on the twin
ligaments.today: Organism: a clerk-declared godown temperature (31.4 C) lands on the Langthasa entity and Teron cell. Live sensors and two GitHub IoT systems still missing.
ligaments.contract: One ownership model. Readings land on the village twin and the plot, never in a private silo.
ligaments.thought: Feet that do not tell the body where they stand are decoration.

ligaments.name: Planted crop is a cell fact
ligaments.today: Organism: harvest closes one Magh planting on the named plot. Kramsapi still holds seed in the ground. GitHub crop_plantings still collide.
ligaments.contract: One planted-crop fact per farmer-plot-season, referenced by twin, insurance, and contract.
ligaments.thought: If the organism cannot say what is in the ground, it cannot promise what will be sold.

ligaments.name: Weather as reflex
ligaments.today: Organism: Magh rain opens a claim window on POL-LANGTHASA-WEATHER. Logistics does not retask. EMI is not frozen. Premium stays undeclared.
ligaments.contract: weather.alert is an artery event. Insurance, finance, logistics, and crop subscribe with documented reflexes.
ligaments.thought: A warning that does not move a muscle is gossip.

ligaments.name: Moratorium reflex
ligaments.today: Organism: weather.alert proposes a moratorium. Finance does not auto-freeze EMI. The clerk still commands the pause.
ligaments.contract: Hazard windows offer a pause before a default, attributed to the village twin.
ligaments.thought: Extracting EMI through a flood is not rural finance. It is a disconnected organ.

ligaments.name: Festival recipe lifts forecast
ligaments.today: Culinary platform is entirely missing, so demand cannot know why millet moves in November.
ligaments.contract: Recipe calendar emits spikes. Demand revises. Contract farming is offered before sowing.
ligaments.thought: Culture is the most honest forecast. The organism forgot it had a memory.

ligaments.name: Forecast becomes offtake
ligaments.today: Organism: settlement offers Magh 2027 at settled kilograms. Price is null until a clerk declares it.
ligaments.contract: When forecast confidence clears a threshold, the ligament offers a next-season contract to the cell.
ligaments.thought: A farmer should not have to guess the city. The organism already felt the pull.

ligaments.name: Food Utility ranks the shelf
ligaments.signal: food.utility { sku, nutrition, satiety, taste, rupees, culture }
ligaments.today: Organism: FUS-v1 ranks Chakhao and ginger on declared food axes. Affordability stays blank. Household baskets still missing.
ligaments.contract: Listings carry FUS. Goal-based baskets (diabetic, child, harvest-week) query the graph, not keywords.
ligaments.thought: People do not shop for SKUs. They shop for a full stomach that their family will eat.

ligaments.name: ₹ per cold kilometre
ligaments.today: Freight tables ignore diesel, inverter, and outage. RECIE is missing.
ligaments.contract: Every shipment quotes energy and spoilage risk as first-class cost, not overhead.
ligaments.thought: Cold chain that cannot say ₹ per kg moved is not logistics. It is hope.

ligaments.name: Village energy cloud schedules digestion
ligaments.today: Organism: the village energy cloud has an active window and a recorded Magh outage. kWh stays undeclared. Mills block on an active outage.
ligaments.contract: Mills and chillers run when the cloud says power is cheapest and most reliable.
ligaments.thought: Digestion that ignores breath will choke.

ligaments.name: Spoilage hits the village ledger
ligaments.today: Organism: a declared spoilage cuts remaining grams and posts the village ledger. Insurance and energy hear. Premium and kWh stay undeclared unless a clerk names them.
ligaments.contract: spoilage.event posts to claim, energy loss, and village TCO in one write.
ligaments.thought: Waste is the organism’s fever. A fever hidden in one module is how villages stay poor.

ligaments.name: Asset booking reshapes the season
ligaments.today: Rental is a catalog. The farm calendar does not move.
ligaments.contract: A booked dryer or tractor writes into the plot calendar and the yield model.
ligaments.thought: Shared muscle that does not move the body is a brochure.

ligaments.name: Spine carries live lots, not copies
ligaments.today: Organism: rural ERP is the books — lots, remaining grams, journal. GitHub erpService is still a second master.
ligaments.contract: ERP is a subscriber and publisher on the spine, never a second master.
ligaments.thought: Two skeletons cannot share one body.

ligaments.name: Nervous system fires muscles
ligaments.today: Organism: Module OS and companion fire harvest, intake, offtake, consult. GitHub is sixteen sibling services.
ligaments.contract: The coordinator is the only brain. Domain AIs are tissues. Reflexes are declared, auditable, and rupee-attributed.
ligaments.thought: A chatbot bolted onto a module is not a nervous system. It is a mouth without a spine.

ligaments.name: Scheme knowledge as subsidy blood
ligaments.today: Organism: PM-KISAN, PMFBY, and MIDH eligibility compute from acres, plantings, and horticulture. Amount stays undeclared. Finance does not auto-compose a product.
ligaments.contract: Eligibility is computed on the cell and offered as a composed product, not a PDF hunt.
ligaments.thought: A scheme the farmer must discover alone is not inclusion.

ligaments.name: Farmer is a cell, not a role
ligaments.today: Organism: farmer is a household cell with acres and harvest. GitHub still RBAC roles.
ligaments.contract: UX and data treat the farmer as the nucleus. Other organs report what they did for this cell, in rupees.
ligaments.thought: Roles are doors. Cells are lives. The consolidated branch still thinks in doors.

ligaments.name: Village is an economy
ligaments.today: Organism: Langthasa village ledger books declared energy, water, freight, and spoilage grams. No 25-year TCO optimizer.
ligaments.contract: Every intervention answers: how many rupees per year does this save the village economy?
ligaments.thought: A pin on a map cannot be prosperous. An economy can.

ligaments.name: Food is culture, not a SKU
ligaments.today: Products have name, price, GI tag. No satiety, no grandmother, no festival, no household goal.
ligaments.contract: Every lot can answer who eats it, when, why it fills, and whether a child will accept it.
ligaments.thought: Northeast GI produce dies in a catalog the moment it is stripped of kitchen and calendar.

ligaments.name: Energy is lifetime ₹, not MW
ligaments.today: If energy appears at all, it is capacity. The missing-platforms analysis already named the inversion. Code did not.
ligaments.contract: KPIs are ₹/kg crop, ₹/litre chilled, ₹/hour irrigation — never MW installed.
ligaments.thought: Installing solar into a silo is how projects look complete and villages stay expensive.

ligaments.name: GI is heritage plus livelihood
ligaments.today: Organism: a GI lot carries cell, Langthasa geography, and the mint chain — or it cannot be sold as GI. Kitchen memory sits beside it. GitHub still a certification flag.
ligaments.contract: A GI lot shows the cell, the geography, the kitchen, and the rupee split — or it is not GI.
ligaments.thought: A tag without a livelihood is branding. A livelihood without a tag is theft.

ligaments.name: Prosperity path on every organ
ligaments.today: Organism: charter names a rupee path per module. Missing organs still have no prosperity metric.
ligaments.contract: No organ ships without a prosperity metric, a signal, and a named cell it nourishes.
ligaments.thought: One hundred and fifty-six independent concepts can all be ‘implemented’ and the organism still be dead.

ligaments.name: Contract is trust in time
ligaments.today: Contracts have statuses. They do not feel like a season-long ligament of escrow and care.
ligaments.contract: The farmer can see, at any week, what is promised, what is in escrow, and what the offtake still owes.
ligaments.thought: Paper in a portal is not a bond. Time with money held in common is.

ligaments.name: AI is a nervous system
ligaments.today: Organism: one bus, pass/block/defer/propose, AI rupeeWrite forbidden. GitHub AI is still a directory.
ligaments.contract: If it cannot sense, decide, act, and learn on the same event, it is not the nervous system. Hide it.
ligaments.thought: Intelligence that does not close a loop is literature.

ligaments.name: Household goal becomes a basket
ligaments.today: Cart is SKU-in, SKU-out. No diabetic, child, or harvest-week goal.
ligaments.contract: A goal compiles to a basket that the market can fill from living lots.
ligaments.thought: Commerce should start from a life, not from a grid of cards.

ligaments.name: ₹ per litre chilled
ligaments.today: Livestock records headcount. Chilling energy is unmeasured.
ligaments.contract: Milk chilling posts to RECIE. Outage spoilage posts to insurance and RCOP.
ligaments.thought: A litre that warmed overnight is a silent withdrawal from the cell.

ligaments.name: Animals are cell assets
ligaments.today: livestockService sits beside farmerService. Headcount does not nourish FDI or household cashflow.
ligaments.contract: Every animal is a fact on the cell. Yield, veterinary cost, and chill cost write into FDI.
ligaments.thought: A second genome that does not feed the nucleus is a side module.

ligaments.name: Herd cover on the same immune system
ligaments.today: Organism: Ronghang cattle and goats bind POL-LANGTHASA-HERD. Premium undeclared. Milk settlement and disease claims still missing.
ligaments.contract: Outage that warms milk and disease that thins a herd both open cover on the spine.
ligaments.thought: Immunity that only knows grain will let the other genome die quietly.

ligaments.name: Dairy cashflow metabolises credit
ligaments.today: Credit scoring does not hear litre-days. Dairy society management is GAP-0047, documented only.
ligaments.contract: Regular milk settlement is as legitimate a credit pulse as a crop offtake.
ligaments.thought: Daily milk is the most honest cashflow a cell has. Finance that ignores it is guessing.

ligaments.name: Milk becomes food, not a row
ligaments.today: Processing and livestock never share a lot. Chilling is nobody’s schedule.
ligaments.contract: Intake at the chiller is the harvest event of the second genome.
ligaments.thought: Digestion that only knows grain has forgotten half the village.

ligaments.name: Milk and meat as living lots
ligaments.today: Marketplace is a GI crop storefront. Dairy lots are not born from chill events.
ligaments.contract: A chilled litre can be listed with energy cost and farmer cell already on it.
ligaments.thought: If the shelf cannot sell what the herd just gave, the organism is only a crop app.

ligaments.name: Digested lot returns as food
ligaments.today: Processed SKUs are catalogued by hand. They do not carry the parent lot, energy, or farmer split.
ligaments.contract: Output lots inherit GI, cell, energy, and FUS from the intake lot.
ligaments.thought: Value addition that forgets the cell is a factory with a rural URL.

ligaments.name: Reserve feeds digestion
ligaments.today: Organism: processMass shrinks remaining in place with declared loss. No child milled lot yet.
ligaments.contract: The same lot object moves. Moisture and GI do not get retyped.
ligaments.thought: Fat that cannot become muscle is obesity. Grain that cannot become food is a silo.

ligaments.name: Process changes food utility
ligaments.today: FVIE is missing, so milling, puffing, and fermenting never change a score.
ligaments.contract: Each process is a transformation of FUS, not only of SKU code.
ligaments.thought: A mill that does not know satiety is just a motor.

ligaments.name: Handler added to the marker
ligaments.today: Trace is minted, if at all, as a product badge. Process does not append.
ligaments.contract: Every handler is a link. A GI claim after anonymous milling is a lie.
ligaments.thought: Immunity that stops at the farm gate is a sticker.

ligaments.name: Village muscle lives on the twin
ligaments.today: Asset rental is a catalog. The village twin was specified and never attached.
ligaments.contract: Every shared dryer, tractor, and cold room is a node on the twin with a rupee save.
ligaments.thought: Muscle that does not belong to a body is equipment photography.

ligaments.name: Shared vs individual is a liver question
ligaments.today: RCOP is missing. Rental does not answer the only question the liver asks.
ligaments.contract: Booking is allowed only after the twin says this save beats owning it alone.
ligaments.thought: A catalog of tractors is not an economy. A decision is.

ligaments.name: Shared dryers draw village breath
ligaments.today: Dryers and pumps are booked as if power were free.
ligaments.contract: Shared loads register on the energy cloud. Outage reschedules the booking.
ligaments.thought: Village muscle that ignores breath will seize.

ligaments.name: Pumping is an energy fact
ligaments.today: No water organ. Irrigation load is named in RECIE and then left as a bullet.
ligaments.contract: Every pumped litre posts kWh to RECIE and stress to the aquifer twin.
ligaments.thought: Water and energy are one breath. Split them and both KPIs lie.

ligaments.name: Irrigation writes the season
ligaments.today: Crop calendars do not hear pump hours or canal rotations.
ligaments.contract: A planted-crop fact includes water cost and stress, or it is not a season plan.
ligaments.thought: A genome that cannot drink on time is a spreadsheet.

ligaments.name: ₹ per litre on the village ledger
ligaments.today: RCOP lists water as a cost category. There is no engine.
ligaments.contract: Shared storage vs private borewell is a liver decision, shown in rupees per year.
ligaments.thought: The cheapest water is the litre the village did not have to lift twice.

ligaments.name: Aquifer on the habitat twin
ligaments.today: Village is a place field. GAP-0078 water monitoring is documented only.
ligaments.contract: The twin carries aquifer, tanks, and rights — not only houses.
ligaments.thought: A habitat that cannot say what it drinks is a pin.

ligaments.name: Herd water is not leftover irrigation
ligaments.today: Livestock and irrigation never share a water budget.
ligaments.contract: Dairy and draught have a reserved quality and cost on the same fluid organ.
ligaments.thought: Animals that drink last are how a second genome is quietly sacrificed.

ligaments.name: Membership is collective tissue
ligaments.today: Organism: Magh FPO membership is tissue; offtake splits qty-weighted. GitHub FPO is an ACL role.
ligaments.contract: The cell remains a nucleus. The FPO is tissue it can act through.
ligaments.thought: A login named FPO is not a cooperative. A pooled harvest is.

ligaments.name: Collective offtake before sowing
ligaments.today: Organism: pool offtake is FIFO remaining grams, then qty-weighted farmgate. GitHub contracts still open on a form.
ligaments.contract: When veins pull, the FPO is offered volume the cell could not underwrite alone.
ligaments.thought: Small farms grow a spine by promising together. Alone they sell distress.

ligaments.name: Group credit on pooled health
ligaments.today: PACS and SHG management are GAP-0045/0046 — documented only. Credit is individual.
ligaments.contract: Group line reprices from pooled FDI, offtake, and storage — explained in rupees.
ligaments.thought: Extracting EMI from one flooded cell while the FPO sits idle is not rural finance.

ligaments.name: FPO as the public hand
ligaments.today: Organism: pooled listings carry member cells via FIFO split. Kitchen and GI story still thin.
ligaments.contract: The shelf shows the collective and the cells it nourishes, or it is a wholesaler skin.
ligaments.thought: A brand that hides the cell is a mandi with better CSS.

ligaments.name: Collective muscle is booked as one
ligaments.today: Rental catalog is individual. FPO-owned dryers do not reshape member calendars.
ligaments.contract: FPO assets write into every member plot they serve, and into RCOP’s shared-vs-individual.
ligaments.thought: A dryer the members cannot feel in their season plan is a monument.

ligaments.name: Household is the living unit of the cell
ligaments.today: Organism: each cell carries a household name. Not yet a kitchen graph or buffer-days ledger.
ligaments.contract: The cell has a household: mouths, goals, festival plates, and a cash buffer.
ligaments.thought: A farmer without a household is an account. A household is a life.

ligaments.name: Family goal compiles to food utility
ligaments.today: No household, no FVIE. Goals cannot compile.
ligaments.contract: A household goal is the query. FUS is the answer. The cart is a consequence.
ligaments.thought: Nutrition apps that start from a catalog have already lost the family.

ligaments.name: Household cashflow, not only farm EMI
ligaments.today: Organism: cell statement is farmgate minus inputs. School fees and medical shocks are invisible.
ligaments.contract: Credit that cannot see household buffer will call a health shock a default.
ligaments.thought: Rural finance that only sees the plot is extracting from a life it refuses to model.

ligaments.name: Kitchen remembers why the crop exists
ligaments.today: Organism: Magh kitchen is a village graph, not yet a household plate ledger.
ligaments.contract: Each household contributes dishes to the graph. The graph returns sowing advice.
ligaments.thought: The most accurate demand sensor in a village is a grandmother’s winter list.

ligaments.name: Plates return as veins
ligaments.today: Demand is an AI POST. Households never speak.
ligaments.contract: Repeat plates, skipped weeks, and festival spikes are first-class veins.
ligaments.thought: Forecasting without plates is astrology with a neural net.

ligaments.name: Eligibility computed on the cell
ligaments.today: Government knowledge is a missing REOS layer. Farmers hunt PDFs.
ligaments.contract: The cell carries land, FDI, crop, and livestock facts. Eligibility is a function, not a form.
ligaments.thought: A benefit the nucleus cannot feel is a press release.

ligaments.name: Village-scale schemes on the twin
ligaments.today: No twin, so feeder solarisation and community storage cannot be composed.
ligaments.contract: Community schemes land on the twin with a liver answer: rupees per year saved.
ligaments.thought: Individual rooftop in a village that needed a feeder is how subsidies miss.

ligaments.name: PM-KUSUM composed into energy cost
ligaments.today: Energy platforms are missing, so subsidies cannot change lifetime ₹/kWh.
ligaments.contract: A scheme is an input to TCO, not a parallel brochure.
ligaments.thought: Solar with a subsidy still has to beat diesel in rupees. Otherwise it is a photo.

ligaments.name: Irrigation subsidy is a water fact
ligaments.today: No water organ, so irrigation schemes cannot reprice the litre.
ligaments.contract: Eligibility plus pumping cost plus aquifer stress = one composed product.
ligaments.thought: A free pump that lowers an aquifer is not a gift. It is an unpriced fever.

ligaments.name: Subsidy composes with credit, not beside it
ligaments.today: b-gov-scheme already named the gap from AI to finance. The scheme organ itself does not exist.
ligaments.contract: The farmer sees one product: net EMI after subsidy, with renewal and compliance on the cell.
ligaments.thought: Two portals — loan and scheme — is how inclusion becomes homework.

ligaments.name: Harvest is blood, not a page
ligaments.today: Organism: spine_events persist harvest.completed. GitHub eventBus.js is still an in-memory stub.
ligaments.contract: crop.harvested is a spine event. Warehouse, trace, insurance, market, lot all subscribe.
ligaments.thought: A bus that no organ boards is a comment in a file.

ligaments.name: Intake subscribes, does not retype
ligaments.today: Organism: warehouse.intake is a handler on the same lot id. GitHub warehouse still retypes.
ligaments.contract: Intake is a handler on the spine. The lot object is the payload.
ligaments.thought: Capillaries that do not reach the reserve organ leave grain in the field.

ligaments.name: Settlement is a pulse
ligaments.today: Organism: order.settled posts journal and payouts. demand.observed still does not fire.
ligaments.contract: One event, three subscribers: payout, FDI, demand.observed.
ligaments.thought: Muscle that does not return blood is a cramp.

ligaments.name: Nervous system rides the same blood
ligaments.today: Organism: coordinator consults the library; fabric caps spend at 0 paise; companion proposes. GitHub AIs are not subscribers.
ligaments.contract: The coordinator is the only brain. It sees the spine or it is hidden.
ligaments.thought: A brain that does not taste blood is a library of prompts.

ligaments.name: Harvest mints a living lot
ligaments.signal: lot.mint { lotId, variety, kg, moisture, farmerId, villageId }
ligaments.today: Organism: harvest mints erp_lots with remaining_grams = grams. GitHub has no lot object.
ligaments.contract: One lot id from birth. Every later organ appends. None re-create.
ligaments.thought: Identity of produce is the identity of livelihood. Split it and GI becomes a rumour.

ligaments.name: The same body is stored
ligaments.today: Organism: inward is a state of the same lot. GitHub intake invents a warehouse id.
ligaments.contract: Storage is a state of the lot, not a new citizen.
ligaments.thought: A body that is renamed at every door is how traceability dies.

ligaments.name: Marker is a property of the lot
ligaments.today: Organism: GI is a field on the lot. It is not yet an immune mint that blocks GI claims.
ligaments.contract: No GI listing without a marker on this lot. Marker is born with the lot.
ligaments.thought: A certificate that can exist without the sack is a PDF, not an immune marker.

ligaments.name: The shelf sells the lot
ligaments.today: Organism: the shelf sells remaining grams of the lot at a declared price per kg. No FUS on the listing yet.
ligaments.contract: Draft listing is a projection of a living lot. Price can show energy and GI split.
ligaments.thought: Selling a product that is not a lot is selling a photograph of grain.

ligaments.name: Freight moves the same body
ligaments.today: Organism: freight is declared on the offtake. Spoilage does not write back onto the lot.
ligaments.contract: A shipment is a motion of a lot. Fever (spoilage) posts to the lot, then to insurance and RCOP.
ligaments.thought: Arteries that invent a new patient mid-journey cannot treat a fever.

ligaments.name: Cover clings to the lot
ligaments.today: Organism: cover_status lives on the lot. Gap is a spine alert. Premium is never invented.
ligaments.contract: Transit and warehouse cover are states of the lot. A gap is a spine alert.
ligaments.thought: Insurance of a person that ignores the sack is a form. Insurance of the sack is immunity.

ligaments.name: Cloud is how lungs become a schedule
ligaments.today: RECIE 1.6 Village Energy Cloud is specified as missing. No forecast, no allocation.
ligaments.contract: RECIE computes cost. The cloud allocates time. Neither ships without the other.
ligaments.thought: A cost engine without a schedule is an essay. A schedule without cost is a roster.

ligaments.name: Mills run on surplus
ligaments.today: Processing roster is static.
ligaments.contract: Batches wait for cheap, reliable windows. Yield after energy is the KPI.
ligaments.thought: Digestion at peak tariff is how villages pay extra to become poorer.

ligaments.name: Cold rooms breathe with the village
ligaments.today: Holding energy is invisible. Outage spoilage is local.
ligaments.contract: Hold vs release is a cloud+RCOP decision: spoilage risk versus ₹ of power.
ligaments.thought: A dark cold room during an outage is a fever the reserve organ cannot feel.

ligaments.name: Chillers are on the same breath
ligaments.today: Milk chillers are not a load on any cloud.
ligaments.contract: ₹ per litre chilled is scheduled, metered, and claimed into insurance on outage.
ligaments.thought: Warm milk at dawn is the village spending energy it never measured.

ligaments.name: The twin has a weather of power
ligaments.today: No twin, no cloud. Shared-vs-individual energy is an unasked question.
ligaments.contract: The habitat shows the stack: grid, diesel, solar, BESS — and the rupee path.
ligaments.thought: A village that cannot say how it breathes cannot choose a lung.

ligaments.name: Culinary platform is a graph, not a blog
ligaments.today: GCIP is completely missing. There is no graph to hang recipes on.
ligaments.contract: Every recipe is a node with edges to variety, festival, household, and health goal.
ligaments.thought: A recipe page is literature. A graph is memory the economy can use.

ligaments.name: Taste and satiety are edges
ligaments.today: FVIE is missing, so FUS cannot live on the graph.
ligaments.contract: Food Utility is a property of graph nodes, queried by household goals.
ligaments.thought: Scoring food without a kitchen is lab nutrition. Villages do not eat in labs.

ligaments.name: Dishes imply varieties
ligaments.today: Organism: kitchen graph implies Chakhao pithas to Chakhao Poireiton. FVIE still missing.
ligaments.contract: A spike in a dish revises the implied variety before seed is bought.
ligaments.thought: The genome should hear the kitchen. Otherwise it plants for a catalog.

ligaments.name: Festival graph lifts forecast
ligaments.today: Organism: Magh is encoded as a festival on the kitchen edge. Lead-time contract still uses settled qty, not a spike model.
ligaments.contract: The graph emits spikes with lead time enough to contract.
ligaments.thought: Magh is not a residual in a model. It is a memory. Encode it.

ligaments.name: Every path ends at the cell
ligaments.today: Organism: farmgate credits the cell in the same ink as the journal. Village TCO still missing.
ligaments.contract: An organ may not ship a feature that cannot post a rupee to a named cell.
ligaments.thought: Dashboards that cannot nourish are mirrors in an empty room.

ligaments.name: Village TCO is the same ink
ligaments.today: RCOP is missing. farmCosting is a module, not a village ledger.
ligaments.contract: Cell posts and village posts are two views of one ink.
ligaments.thought: A prosperous cell in a bankrupt village is a delay, not a design.

ligaments.name: Hours-to-pay is a prosperity metric
ligaments.today: Settlement skeletons do not write hours-to-pay onto any ledger.
ligaments.contract: Cost of capital and hours-to-pay post beside farmgate price.
ligaments.thought: A good price paid late is a hidden tax. The ledger must show it.

ligaments.name: A reflex must explain the rupee
ligaments.today: AI services return text. They do not have to name a rupee path.
ligaments.contract: If the coordinator cannot post to the ledger, the reflex does not fire.
ligaments.thought: An explanation without a rupee is literature. Hide it.

ligaments.name: Feet trigger the arc
ligaments.today: Advisories are pages. Two IoT systems disagree on ownership.
ligaments.contract: Sense events are the only legal start of a reflex. No human retype.
ligaments.thought: Feet that write a dashboard have not yet become a nervous system.

ligaments.name: Arc opens cover
ligaments.today: Claims wait for a form. Weather does not open them.
ligaments.contract: Documented reflex: hazard → window → evidence from the lot and the twin.
ligaments.thought: Immunity that waits to be asked is a helpdesk.

ligaments.name: Arc offers a pause
ligaments.today: Credit does not hear the sky. Duplicate of the intent in b-weather-finance, now with an arc organ.
ligaments.contract: The offer is automatic, explained, and posted to the rupee ledger.
ligaments.thought: Mercy that requires a petition is not a reflex. It is PR.

ligaments.name: Arc retasks freight
ligaments.today: Freight tables do not move when a road or a chiller fails.
ligaments.contract: Hazard windows reshuffle pooling and cold chain, with spoilage risk priced in.
ligaments.thought: Arteries that cannot flinch will spill the blood they carry.

ligaments.name: The brain owns the arc, not a chat
ligaments.today: Coordinator exists as a file. Reflexes are not declared, auditable, or rupee-attributed.
ligaments.contract: A reflex is a typed object. Domain AIs are tissues it may call. Chat is optional skin.
ligaments.thought: If it cannot fire without a prompt, it is not a spinal cord.

ligaments.name: Release is an artery event
ligaments.today: Warehouse and logistics do not share a lot id. Dispatch is a separate form.
ligaments.contract: Release of a covered, marked lot is the only legal start of a GI shipment.
ligaments.thought: Fat that cannot enter the artery is a warehouse with a gift shop.

ligaments.name: Holding power is a cost, not overhead
ligaments.today: Energy of holding is invisible. Spoilage from outage is local.
ligaments.contract: ₹ of spoilage avoided minus ₹ of holding energy, on the lot, on the cell.
ligaments.thought: Free storage is a lie villages pay for in warm grain.

ligaments.name: A sold lot must move
ligaments.today: Some order-to-ship wiring exists. It does not carry energy, spoilage, or lot identity.
ligaments.contract: The hand that sells already books the artery, priced with breath and fever.
ligaments.thought: A checkout without a journey is a promise the body cannot keep.

ligaments.name: Offtake writes the genome
ligaments.today: Contracts do not write back into crop plans. The farmer sows on hope.
ligaments.contract: A signed offtake is a planted-crop fact waiting to happen.
ligaments.thought: A ligament that does not move the genome is a PDF in a drawer.

ligaments.name: Escrow is the money of trust
ligaments.today: Contracts have statuses. Escrow, if any, is not a pulse the cell can see week by week.
ligaments.contract: Milestones release escrow onto the rupee ledger, visible to the cell.
ligaments.thought: Trust in time is money held in common — or it is stationery.

ligaments.name: A dish names a variety
ligaments.today: No culinary graph, so Chakhao is a catalog name, not a kitchen fact.
ligaments.contract: Every traditional dish points at varieties the genome can plan.
ligaments.thought: Heritage that cannot name a seed is a museum. Heritage that names a seed is a livelihood.

ligaments.name: The habitat returns what it ate
ligaments.today: Demand is national-looking and village-blind.
ligaments.contract: Each habitat is a demand node. Festival, tourism, and institutional pull sit on the twin.
ligaments.thought: A village that cannot say what it eats will always be surprised by what it should grow.

ligaments.name: ERP rides settlement, does not clone it
ligaments.today: Organism: orders, remaining hold, settlement journal are one books. GitHub ERP catalog is still a copy.
ligaments.contract: ERP is a subscriber. The spine remains the source of lots and settlements.
ligaments.thought: A bony spine that invents its own blood will split the body.

ligaments.name: Master data is not a living lot
ligaments.today: Product sync exists. Live lots and master data diverge the same week.
ligaments.contract: SKU master is a skeleton. The lot is flesh. Sync is one way: flesh to bone, never bone inventing flesh.
ligaments.thought: Catalogues that outrun harvests are how GI becomes a fiction.

ligaments.name: A marker is evidence
ligaments.today: Claims and trace never share a payload.
ligaments.contract: A GI marker plus temperature chain is claim evidence, attached without a scan-and-upload.
ligaments.thought: Immunity that cannot read its own markers will demand paper from a flooded cell.

ligaments.name: Veins decide fresh vs processed
ligaments.today: REOS AI Revenue Engine is missing. Lots do not choose a channel.
ligaments.contract: Demand plus energy plus FUS plus contract decide the channel. The farmer sees the rupee split.
ligaments.thought: Selling everything fresh is a habit. Allocation is an organism.

ligaments.name: Collective tissue sits on the habitat
ligaments.today: FPOs are not nodes on a twin. Villages are place strings.
ligaments.contract: An FPO without a habitat cannot share muscle, aquifer, or feeder.
ligaments.thought: A cooperative that is not of a place is a company. A place without a cooperative is only a pin.

ligaments.name: Livestock is a second genome
ligaments.today: Animals are a module beside crop. Veterinary is a spec. The cell is still a crop farmer in the UX.
ligaments.contract: The nucleus has two genomes. UX, FDI, and the rupee ledger treat both as life, not as tabs.
ligaments.thought: A rural cell that is only a crop row has already been simplified into poverty.

ligaments.name: FPO is tissue, not a role
ligaments.today: RBAC: admin, fpo, farmer, consumer. GAP-0043 says complete the FPO system — as software, not as a body.
ligaments.contract: The farmer remains the nucleus. The FPO is how many nuclei share a bone.
ligaments.thought: Roles are doors. Tissue is how a small life does not stand in the mandi alone.

ligaments.name: The household is the demand unit
ligaments.today: Consumer is a checkout role. Household economy is a missing REOS layer.
ligaments.contract: Offtake, nutrition, and cash buffer are household facts that the cell lives inside.
ligaments.thought: A marketplace that sells to ‘users’ will never feed a family it cannot name.

ligaments.name: Water and energy are one breath
ligaments.today: RECIE names irrigation load. RCOP names water cost. Neither organ exists, and they are listed separately.
ligaments.contract: No energy KPI without water; no water KPI without kWh. The breath is the nexus.
ligaments.thought: A solar pump that ignores the aquifer is a lung that does not ask if the blood is left.

ligaments.name: A scheme is blood, not a PDF
ligaments.today: Schemes are content. Discovery is the farmer’s unpaid labour.
ligaments.contract: Inclusion means the cell is offered a composed product. Search is a failure mode.
ligaments.thought: A portal full of schemes the nucleus must hunt is a library next to a hungry body.

ligaments.name: The lot is one body of produce
ligaments.today: Six modules, six identifiers, one sack. The farmer retypes the harvest.
ligaments.contract: If two organs cannot point at the same lot id, they are not in the same organism.
ligaments.thought: Identity split is how GI, cover, and payout all become someone else’s problem.

ligaments.name: Blood is not bone
ligaments.today: eventBus.js is a stub. erpService is a batch hose. Both claim to be the spine.
ligaments.contract: ERP is bone. The event bus is blood. Bone may carry; it may not invent pulses.
ligaments.thought: Two skeletons cannot share one body. A skeleton cannot bleed.

ligaments.name: Shared infrastructure is village muscle
ligaments.today: Rental is e-commerce for equipment. The habitat does not flex.
ligaments.contract: Muscle is booked, felt in the calendar, and justified in rupees per year on the twin.
ligaments.thought: A brochure of tractors is not a body. Hours a household could not afford alone are.

ligaments.name: Processing is digestion of the same harvest
ligaments.today: Processing is a factory SKU path. Crop is a farmer page. They do not recognise each other.
ligaments.contract: Digestion has a parent lot. Margin after energy returns to the cell that grew it.
ligaments.thought: A mill that does not know the field is a stomach without a mouth.

ligaments.name: Season is culture in the ground
ligaments.today: Calendars are agronomic. Festivals are missing. The two clocks never meet.
ligaments.contract: A season plan names the festival it is for, or it is only weather.
ligaments.thought: Northeast GI produce is grown for a kitchen calendar. Strip the calendar and you strip the reason.

ligaments.name: Power is a weather of the habitat
ligaments.today: If power appears, it is MW. The village does not have a weather of electricity.
ligaments.contract: The habitat feels surplus, outage, and tariff the way it feels monsoon.
ligaments.thought: Installing capacity into a place that cannot feel power is how projects look complete.

ligaments.name: Food memory is not a nutrition label
ligaments.today: Nutrition, if any, is a column. Culture is a tag. Satiety does not exist as a word in the schema.
ligaments.contract: The graph holds why a food fills, who will eat it, and when it must be grown.
ligaments.thought: A label can be true and still be useless at a table where a child refuses the dish.

ligaments.name: A chatbot is not a reflex
ligaments.today: AI is a directory. DORA already named spinal reflex. Code named sixteen services.
ligaments.contract: Sense, decide, act, learn — on one event — or it is hidden from the organism.
ligaments.thought: Intelligence that waits to be prompted during a flood is a spectator.

ligaments.name: Collective offtake is trust at village scale
ligaments.today: Contracts are one-to-one. The FPO is a badge.
ligaments.contract: The ligament can bind many cells at once without erasing any nucleus.
ligaments.thought: The mandi already knows how to crush one farmer. The organism’s answer is a we.

ligaments.name: An aquifer is a commons, not a borewell
ligaments.today: Water, when mentioned, is a pump on a plot.
ligaments.contract: Rights, depth, and quality live on the habitat. The cell may draw; it may not pretend the well is private geology.
ligaments.thought: A prosperous farm over a dead aquifer is a countdown.

ligaments.name: A storefront is not a revenue OS
ligaments.today: Marketplace maturity is scored high. REOS says the revenue operating system is still a shop.
ligaments.contract: Fresh, process, store, export, institutional, subscription — allocated, not merely listed.
ligaments.thought: A beautiful shop that cannot choose a channel will always sell at the worst time.

ligaments.name: Time is the hidden dimension of every ligament
ligaments.today: Modules are present-tense: list, order, store. Seasons, festivals, lead times, and next sowing are not first-class.
ligaments.contract: Every living ligament has a clock: lead time to sowing, hours-to-pay, cover window, festival spike.
ligaments.thought: An organism that cannot remember last Magh will plant next Magh as a surprise. That is how independent concepts stay independent.

ligaments.name: AI systems are modules of one nerve
ligaments.today: moduleSystemFactory.js prints SYS-M* from 544 folders. moduleContract.js classifies function-name prefixes. Neither names a DORA organ.
ligaments.contract: Each AI system registers: operations, organs it may move, pulses it emits, human-approval for commands.
ligaments.thought: A list of folders is an inventory. A synapse is a contract that fires.

ligaments.name: Modules subscribe to blood
ligaments.today: Organism: Module OS workflows subscribe to harvest, intake, offtake. Unknown events fail. GitHub factory does not.
ligaments.contract: Factory.plug writes the event list. Unknown events fail closed. log-and-forget is forbidden.
ligaments.thought: A module that cannot hear blood is a prosthetic in a box.

ligaments.name: Agentic sits with the cell
ligaments.today: Organism: agentic companion proposes; clerk approves with declared kg, loss, paymentRef. GitHub M675100 is still a 1KB re-export.
ligaments.contract: The companion proposes. The cell approves. Commands never execute alone.
ligaments.thought: Autonomy without a nucleus is a chatbot wearing the farmer’s name.

ligaments.name: A proposal that cannot mint a lot is talk
ligaments.today: Organism: companion proposes lot.mint; clerk declares mass; remaining = grams. GitHub copilot is a page.
ligaments.contract: On harvest, agentic proposes one lot body. Human confirms. lot.mint fires. Media, trace, and cover attach to that id.
ligaments.thought: If the companion cannot point at the sack, it is not in the same organism as the harvest.

ligaments.name: Sixteen mouths are not one arc
ligaments.today: Advisory, self-heal, ops-intel, conversational, and voice are sibling modules. weatherAdvisory is still a page.
ligaments.contract: One reflex arc. Many tissues. Advisory explains; companion proposes; nerve fires muscle.
ligaments.thought: A mouth for every department is how a body forgets it has a spine.

ligaments.name: WIRED is not complete
ligaments.today: module.json status WIRED, wiredVerification: loads and delegates. analysis.isComplete false. Completeness: routes false, tests false.
ligaments.contract: A module is complete when it plugs, emits, and can name a rupee. Loading a re-export is not wiring.
ligaments.thought: The most expensive lie in this repo is the word WIRED on a skeleton.

ligaments.name: Every module shows a rupee path
ligaments.today: Organism: AI cannot write rupees; fabric spend cap is 0 paise. No module yet posts a farmer rupee it moved.
ligaments.contract: fabric.allow spends paise against a cell, not a cloud bill. A proposal without ₹ is hidden.
ligaments.thought: Intelligence that cannot count the cell’s money is decoration with a GPU.

ligaments.name: Concept-to-runtime matrix
ligaments.today: Every named concept is classified. Stage 0 is done. GitHub still has no single source of truth.
ligaments.contract: Nothing removed. Dual-truth. Verified / partial / scaffolded / documented / disconnected / duplicated / blocked / proposed / missing.
ligaments.thought: A COMPLETE certificate without a remaining gram is a cadaver with a stamp.

ligaments.name: Evidence passport on the sack
ligaments.signal: lot.passport { gi, cover, remaining, paymentRef, journal }
ligaments.today: Each lot carries provenance atoms. Absent stays absent. Premium is never invented.
ligaments.contract: Attach issuer, date, confidence, consent. Do not fill blanks.
ligaments.thought: Trust is a chain of declared facts, not a star rating.

ligaments.name: Need is the door
ligaments.today: Books and OS board open on the problem, not the module name.
ligaments.contract: Navigation begins with the cell’s work. Module folders stay backstage.
ligaments.thought: A farmer who must know M675100 has already been excluded.

ligaments.name: Four-level enhance, not a thousand pages
ligaments.today: Every classified concept is enhanced at four simultaneous levels. GitHub still generates sibling pages.
ligaments.contract: Component explains. Industry stays native. Rural opens on need. Future is named, never claimed.
ligaments.thought: A COMPLETE stamp on a missing organ is a cadaver with a ribbon.

ligaments.name: Ethical constitution on the cell
ligaments.today: No inferred caste, religion, health. AI cannot write rupees. Auth-off is the non-personalized default.
ligaments.contract: Voluntary constraints cannot set price, credit, employment, insurance, or eligibility.
ligaments.thought: Assistance that profiles a cell against its will is not intelligence. It is extraction.

ligaments.name: Suitability refuses invented offers
ligaments.today: Find-a-loan is a refusal. Cover may bind. Premium stays unknown.
ligaments.contract: Do not recommend a loan, travel clone, or invented quote.
ligaments.thought: A recommendation without a declared rupee is a trap with a smile.

ligaments.name: Village grievance from the gate
ligaments.today: Journal, paymentRef, pledged sack, minted-not-inward become cases. Government appeal is still named.
ligaments.contract: Complaint → ack → evidence. Do not fake-close an insurance or scheme dispute.
ligaments.thought: A chat that swallows a complaint is a second mouth with no teeth.

ligaments.name: Living events, named disasters
ligaments.today: Harvest, intake, settle, spoilage, cover fire. Flood and price-crash are named, not simulated as ₹.
ligaments.contract: Unknown events fail. They do not forget. Named is not living.
ligaments.thought: A reflex that invents a rupee is a seizure, not a muscle.

ligaments.name: Agriculture walk is the native journey
ligaments.signal: os.journey { plot → harvest → store → sell → settle }
ligaments.today: Agriculture is living. Travel, banking, engineering stay named. Finance and procure still missing.
ligaments.contract: Do not clone the books dashboard for insurance or travel.
ligaments.thought: One journey worn by every industry is a uniform that fits no one.
